title: 20 Watts Was Enough
description:
A biologically inspired research blueprint and evidence framework for sparse, grounded, continual, and energy-efficient artificial intelligence. The archive contains the maintained concept chapters, a stable claim ledger, a deduplicated principle registry, experiment candidate and fixture contracts, bounded development harnesses, publication tooling and the tag-bound full-concept book PDF.

This is a blueprint and evidence framework, not an experimental result: no workstation experiment in this archive is claim-eligible, and every experiment image carries the NO_RESULT authority boundary. The research-output disclosure for each version is in research/disclosures/.
notes: Split licence: project-authored software and technical execution material under EUPL-1.2 or later; original research and presentation material, including the book, under CC BY-SA 4.0; third-party material keeps its own terms. See LICENSING.md in the archive.
